data.name: Aqqad
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'Aqd' meaning 'to tie' or 'to bind'. This name is used to describe someone who is strong, steadfast, and firm in their beliefs and actions. In Islamic history, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) used the term 'Aqd' to describe the covenant or bond between Allah and His servants. Thus, the name Aqqad is a powerful reminder of our connection to Allah and the importance of staying true to our faith.

in_arabic.name: عقاد
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من عقد، يعني من يجمع ويربط
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عربي مشتق من كلمة عقد، والتي تعني الربط أو الجمع. يُستخدم هذا الاسم في العديد من الثقافات الإسلامية للإشارة إلى الشخص الذي يربط أو يجمع بين الأشياء، سواء كانت هذه الأشياء مادية أو معنوية. كما يمكن أن يشير إلى الشخص الذي يتمتع بقدرة على التأليف والتركيب.

in_urdu.name: عقاد
in_urdu.meaning: عقد سے مشتق، مطلب ہے جو جمع کرتا ہے اور بندھتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: عقاد ایک عربی نام ہے جو عقد سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے ربط یا جمع کرنا۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافتوں میں اس شخص کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو چیزیں ایک ساتھ جمع کرتا ہے یا مربوط کرتا ہے، چاہے وہ مادی ہو یا غیر مادی۔ یہ کسی ایسے شخص کی طرف بھی اشارہ کرسکتا ہے جس کے پاس چیزوں کو ترتیب دینے اور ساخت دینے کی صلاحیت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अक़्काद
in_hindi.meaning: अक़द से बना, मतलब है जो इकट्ठा करता है और बांधता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: अक़्काद एक अरबी नाम है जो अक़द से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है बाँधना या इकट्ठा करना। यह नाम इस्लामी संस्कृतियों में उस व्यक्ति के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो चीजों को एक साथ इकट्ठा करता है या जोड़ता है, चाहे वह भौतिक हो या अमूर्त। यह उस व्यक्ति की ओर भी संकेत कर सकता है जिसके पास चीजों को व्यवस्थित करने और संरचना प्रदान करने की क्षमता है।

in_english.name: Aqqad
in_english.meaning: Derived from Arabic root 'aqad', meaning one who binds or collects
in_english.long_meaning: The name Aqqad originates from the Arabic root 'aqad', which means to bind or collect. It is used in Islamic cultures to refer to someone who brings things together, whether tangible or intangible. The name may also signify a person with the ability to compose, arrange, and give structure to things. Etymologically related to the concept of 'aqd' (عقد), which appears in the Quran, the name Aqqad carries a rich history and spiritual significance in Islamic tradition.

data.cultural_impact: The name Aqqad symbolizes strength and stability. In Arab culture, names are deeply significant and often reflect the values and traits that a person ought to embody. Aqqad is a name that evokes the idea of a person who is strong, unwavering, and resilient. It is a name that is admired and respected, and can be a source of pride for the person who bears it.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Aqqad holds great spiritual significance in Islam. It is a reminder of the covenant or bond that exists between Allah and His servants. The term 'Aqd' is mentioned in the Quran, where Allah says, "And [all] that We have given you [Muhammad] as an inheritage from us is [a matter] of testimony in the worlds." (An-Naml 27:2). This verse refers to the divine contract or covenant that Allah has made with His Prophet Muhammad, and by extension, with all of his followers. The name Aqqad serves as a constant reminder of this covenant, and the importance of staying true to the faith and fulfilling the obligations that come with it. It is a name that inspires commitment, resolution, and consciousness of the divine bond.
